tests.common.start_hint: Click, tap with the pen or press Space / Enter to start
tests.rate.title: Report rate test
tests.rate.instructions: Draw large, continuous circles with the pen for about 5 seconds at your normal playing speed. This measures how many positions per second the cursor receives.
tests.stillness.title: Stability test
tests.stillness.instructions: Rest the pen tip on the tablet and do not move it for about 5 seconds. You can also hold it in the air, very close to the surface (hover), without moving it. This measures how much the cursor shakes.
tests.tracking.title: Tracking test
tests.tracking.instructions: A pink dot will move in a figure eight at constant speed for about 8 seconds. Follow the dot with your cursor as closely as you can. This measures delay, error and smoothness.
tests.aim.title: Aim test
tests.aim.instructions: 20 circles will appear one at a time. You do NOT need to click: just move the pen onto each circle as fast as you can, with the tip touching the tablet or hovering above it, whichever you play with. A circle counts the moment the cursor touches it, and the next one appears right away. Aim for the center dot: it measures your speed and how precisely you stop on the target.
tests.aim.running: Move onto the circle (no click needed)
tests.aim.instructions_center: 20 circles will appear one at a time. You do NOT need to click: just move the pen to the center of each circle as fast as you can, with the tip touching the tablet or hovering above it, whichever you play with. A circle counts the moment the cursor reaches its center zone (the dashed ring), and the next one appears right away.
tests.aim.running_center: Move to the center of the circle (no click needed)
tests.aim.instructions_click: 20 circles will appear one at a time. Click the center of each one (pen tip is left click) quickly and accurately.
